shortDefinition.en: A family of sensor formats smaller than 36 × 24 mm; exact dimensions and nominal crop factor vary.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 一类小于 36 × 24 mm 的传感器画幅，具体尺寸和标称画幅系数会有差异。

en: APS-C does not mean exactly half the full-frame area. A half-frame film exposure describes how much of a 35 mm roll one picture uses.
zh-cn: 数码摄影中俗称的「半画幅」常指 APS-C，面积不一定是全画幅的一半。胶片「半格」说的是一张照片用多少 35 mm 胶卷的曝光区域。

example.en: The Fujifilm X-T5 uses a 23.5 × 15.7 mm APS-C sensor, about 43% of 36 × 24 mm by area.
example.zh-cn: 富士 X-T5 使用 23.5 × 15.7 mm APS-C 传感器，面积约为 36 × 24 mm 的 43%。

sources.title: FUJIFILM X-T5 Specifications
sources.supports: The dimensions of one specific APS-C sensor, not every APS-C camera.

sources.title: RICOH Imaging PENTAX 17 Features
sources.supports: The half-frame film term describes the per-picture exposure area on 35 mm film.
